_meta.what_this_is: The source data for a generated index file, plus the committed version of that generated file. 'items' is the source (in arbitrary order); a generator renders it into an index. 'committed' is what is checked into the repo as the generated artifact -- but it was hand-edited (one line changed), so a rebuild will not match it. The module builds the index two ways (with and without a build timestamp) and runs the rebuild-then-diff gate against 'committed'.
_meta.committed_is: A FIXTURE: the deterministic render of items, with line 3 hand-edited to simulate someone editing the generated file instead of the source. The gate must catch it.
